title: On an Absolute Thermometric Scale founded on Carnot’s Theory of the Motive Power of Heat, and calculated from Regnault’s Observations
version: Original Philosophical Magazine 33 (October 1848), pp. 313–317; Jena scan hosted at Pittsburgh
lineage: Contemporary primary text. The entire short article was inspected; its first scale definition and doubts are not replaced by Thomson’s later positions.
